events.title: Marc Gerrard
events.description: Marc Gerrard is the guy sneaking warm, wobbly dance music into your bloodstream one track at a time. Originally from England and now based on Vancouver Island, he’s spent years building dancefloors, late-night parties, and immersive music spaces through Abstract Audio, DE Radio, and curating the electronic music stage at the Woodstove Festival. His sets lean deep, playful, and patiently hypnotic — the kind that start with head nods and somehow end with strangers becoming best friends at 4am. Come for the groove, stay for the accidental spiritual experience.
